newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Light still a Flemings buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Light still a Flemings buy.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming & Co said it has reiterated its buy recommendation on Brazilian power distributor Light.
-- "We continue to view Light as one of the best ways to play the Brazilian electricity sector," analyst Walter Stoeppelwerth said in a report.
-- Light's first-quarter results were far from spectacular but did come close to Flemings' margin targets for the full year, he said.
-- The firm posted a first-quarter net income of 81.2 million reais and operating profit of 144.4 million reais, up 18 percent from the same period last year, he added.
-- Net sales, while depressed in the first quarter, should reach 118 million reais in 1997 versus 90.7 million reais in 1996, Flemings said.
-- Light is in talks with Petrobras to buy 2.6 million cubic meters of gas for a 690 megawatt power plant and a deal may be announced late in 1997, it said.
-- Light's net debt is just 188.5 million reais, giving it room to take part in upcoming power sector privatizations and invest in generators, it added.
-- Light common ended at 490 reais Monday in Sao Paulo.
